# MapLibre GL JS 5.24.0

These files are vendored so standalone FireRisk module pages do not depend on
the unpinned UNPKG runtime URL.

Source package: `maplibre-gl@5.24.0`

Source URLs:

```text
https://unpkg.com/maplibre-gl@5.24.0/dist/maplibre-gl.js
https://unpkg.com/maplibre-gl@5.24.0/dist/maplibre-gl.css
https://unpkg.com/maplibre-gl@5.24.0/LICENSE.txt
```

SHA-256 checksums:

```text
45a9b07a9189ce56054c620a947ccf41e291e58c95e9b61533b740aaa65ee5cb  maplibre-gl.js
ab1e70d59ec40465bae7e7030da2f3ccf28133fd502e62bd598eefbadfd7a732  maplibre-gl.css
ee5fc05a0677eaf69601d2c7db0d9ecd6cc27c3abc1d0733bc9ed34707cf8ef2  LICENSE.txt
```

The BSD-3-Clause license text is retained in `LICENSE.txt`. OpenStreetMap
raster tiles remain an external basemap source; FireRisk overlays and a local
background still render when those tiles are unavailable.
